| [0021 — One Content API for Joomla, WordPress and EmDash](adr/0021-one-content-api-for-three-cms.md) | 0021 — One Content API for Joomla, WordPress and EmDash |
| [0022 — The quickstart contract is advice, not a lock](adr/0022-quickstart-contract-is-advice.md) | A quickstart's content contract is advice for keeping the design, not a lock — a quickstart site refuses only one thing, writing straight into the database; supersedes ADR 0020 and every "content-only" lock layer on Joomla, WordPress and EmDash |
| [0023 — A site is bound to a named design system](adr/0023-site-bound-to-a-design-system.md) | A customer site is bound to a named design system — the profile contract names the system, the site folder records the system it currently wears, the agent is instructed by token name, the output is inspected by value in Chrome and only receives warnings; learned from how Claude Design attaches a system to a project |
| [0024 — A backup is a complete restore point (files + database), replacing the Release concept for customers](adr/0024-backup-is-a-complete-restore-point.md) | Backup replaces Release on the customer screen — one restore point made of a file seal and a consistent database dump in one door; each point declares what it holds; two restore scopes (files / everything) with an automatic snapshot right before; the dump lives next to the site, never goes out to the client; the v1 baseline becomes the first backup |
| [0025 — Tracy closes a comment when there is write evidence, and only then](adr/0025-close-comment-on-write-evidence.md) | A comment sent to Tracy is Resolved automatically when the Apply door has write evidence (answered_at) for the latest send exactly; without that mark it stays open and says "couldn't confirm"; one report at the end of the chat turn built from server data; "Ask Tracy to edit all" does not pre-tick a comment already sent with nothing new — reverses the stage 6 rule "a chat turn never changes a comment's status" |
| [0026 — Notifications: Inbox and email for person-to-person events](adr/0026-inbox-and-email-notifications.md) | Tracy's notifications (Inbox + email) are only for important person-to-person events — the site's team and comments; the server writes one row per recipient into tracy-web's Postgres, the Inbox polls every 30 seconds, email goes through a retry queue; email in the RECIPIENT's language (chosen → device if one of the 8 → English); 6 groups × 2 channels, the join-request group is locked on; no notifications for agent work; kept 90 days; site name looked up at read time |
| [0027 — `dsh-passwords`: upstream as the base, Tracy as a policy layer](adr/0027-dsh-passwords-upstream-base-tracy-policy-layer.md) | From now on the `dsh-passwords` fork = the untouched upstream core (pinned to one commit) + a Tracy policy layer in `src/tracy/` plugged into the core through a closed list of hooks; seats are fail-closed; an upstream upgrade replaces the core and reruns the layer's test suite, no line merging |
| [0028 — Three roles: Viewer, Editor, Owner](adr/0028-viewer-editor-owner-roles.md) | Seats on a site and on a workspace now have only three Google-style roles — Viewer (view only, comment, ask the agent), Editor (edit the whole site, including publish), Owner (adds people management, domains, deleting the site); the role → toolset matrix customisable per site/workspace is dropped |
| [0029 — The Template Customization Question Readiness check: static check, /ops scores, a skill fixes](adr/0029-template-customization-question-readiness.md) | A template may be Published only when it passes the Template Customization Question Readiness check ("what the website must achieve" after Customize your site); the check is a static check (reads existing data, builds no site), /ops runs and scores it, a skill lets an admin fix and re-release; real tests only serve to find new rules; not a CI gate |
| [0030 — Desktop is a shell around the web](adr/0030-desktop-is-a-shell-around-the-web.md) | The desktop app is a shell around the web — a feature the web can do is built on the web first, and the app renders the same pages so it gets it for free; the app does on its own only what the web cannot (saving files to the machine, scheme, windows, auto-update); users are steered to install the app with words and layout, never by cutting web features; applies to UI/UX and the design system alike |
| [0031 — The Template Design System Readiness suite: static check, /ops scores, skill fixes](adr/0031-template-design-system-readiness.md) | A template may be Published only when it passes the Template Design System Readiness suite (TDSR, the template declares the design system to standard) — the static check is a cheap, diagnostic gate, measurements on a built site (a separate measuring machine pushes them up through an authenticated receiving door) decide pass/fail at the Design system step of Road to live, the tdsr skill lets an agent fix and re-release; copies the Customize your site suite exactly (ADR 0029); a missing slot contract only warns; revised 13/10/2026 |
| [0032 — Rename the Workspace label following the original letter case](adr/0032-workspace-rename-keeps-letter-case.md) | Rename the Workspace label following the original letter case; keep lowercase workspace and technical identifiers. |
| [0033 — Talking by voice: chaining STT → agent → TTS](adr/0033-voice-chat-stt-agent-tts.md) | Talking with Tracy by voice — chain the existing STT → dsh agent → TTS relay in tracy-web; one voice switch; the ear opens a session when it hears sound; say what is being done from the session's own event window; Chat or Voice for each chat, like the ChatGPT app; interruptions and turn-taking like a real consultant; fast sentence settling, quota by seconds of audio, the agent opens its answer with a part meant to be read aloud. |
